amendment: Treat a best-of-N subset size larger than the frozen train-system action count as structurally unavailable and select only among valid prespecified sizes.
justification: The frozen balanced system split has seven train-system actions, so the prespecified N=8 baseline cannot be defined. N=2 and N=4 remain unchanged. No replacement N is introduced.
scope: Best-of-N baseline feasibility only; the primary selector, pressure grid, endpoint, and success criterion are unchanged.
